material.name: Cretaceous Field Documentary (natural light)
material.style_instruction: Raw handheld natural-history field footage recorded on location on a Late Cretaceous river floodplain in spring. Unprocessed documentary look with true-to-life muted greens and browns, a restrained honest grade, fine 35mm film grain and deep focus at f/8 so the whole frame is sharp from foreground to the far treeline. Light comes only from the sun and sky as it would on a real field day at about 55 degrees north. Extinct animals follow current palaeontological reconstruction: rough non-reflective pachyderm hide or fine pebbly scales, matte polygonal basement scales, deep biological wrinkles, scars, flies, grey-brown river silt caked on legs and bellies, ribs that visibly move with each breath through clean dry nostrils. Everything carries the weight and imperfection of real wildlife footage filmed by one person who is physically present.
material.negative_prompt: NOT a 3D render, NOT CGI, NOT a video-game cinematic, NOT a movie trailer, NOT concept art, NOT a matte painting, NOT a museum diorama, NOT a resin statue, NOT a plastic toy, NOT plastic or waxy skin, NOT glossy specular scales, NOT god rays, NOT volumetric light beams, NOT studio rim light, NOT beauty lighting, NOT teal-and-orange grade, NOT HDR, NOT oversaturated, NOT shallow depth of field, NOT bokeh, NOT slow motion, NOT a smooth flying camera move, NOT breath vapour, NOT steam, NOT smoke plumes from nostrils, NOT red clay, NOT giant tree ferns, NOT tropical jungle, NOT grass meadow, NOT mountains, NOT a desert, NOT snow, NOT tire tracks, NOT sawn logs, NOT any modern manufactured object, NOT any subtitle, caption, label, icon, watermark or text.
material.scene_prefix: Raw handheld field documentary footage, Hell Creek river floodplain in spring 66 million years ago: small broadleaf trees with sycamore-, magnolia- and laurel-like leaves, a few fan palms and tall dawn redwoods at wet sites, horsetails at the water's edge, leaf litter and moss on grey-brown silt. Natural light only, true colours, deep focus, fine film grain, not a 3D render.
material.lighting: Natural sun and sky only, spring at about 55 degrees north: low raking light near sunrise and sunset, soft overcast or broken cloud, organic micro-shadows, no fill, no god rays, no rim light.
